reviews.title: Broadcast bias concerns
reviews.text: I subscribed to watch the Süper Lig, but this is not about a few matches or occasional mistakes. For years, controversial decisions benefiting certain teams have been replayed repeatedly, while comparable decisions against them are ignored. This consistent pattern cannot reasonably be dismissed as coincidence. The broadcaster’s selective coverage appears designed to shape viewers’ perceptions, raising serious questions about its impartiality and editorial integrity.

reviews.title: Adds should be disclosed on app description
reviews.text:
This review is based on the United States, using iOS devices and mainly watching Sudamérica soccer, I have subscribed annually.

Cons
Even if you are subscribed , you still have to watch ads mostly first time you open app and home page still asking you to subscribe. 
App does not refresh itself you have to do it manually or restart the app and then it will show you another add.
No 4K only HD streaming.
No pause on live games.
You have to pay extra for games in Arabic and Portuguese.
No Picture in Picture or multiple play.
No highlights, even when app description say so, just full game replay.
No international watching or VPN

Pros
It runs smoothly.
Games star streaming around 1 hour before actual game, showing arrivals, warmups and interviews.
Games are available to replay right after live streaming ends.
You can download games.
You can save games and content in Library 
Mostly of the games are available in English and original languages.
